propositions: Auto-deploy restarts the review-bot container during in-flight code reviews, causing the incomplete review to cast a fail-closed LLM-Review -1 vote that blocks the existing backfill reconciler recovery mechanism
The shutdown drain timeout (45s) is too short compared to review timeout (1200s), causing in-flight reviews to be cancelled and corrupted mid-execution
Transient git-fetch hangs burning the 300s timeout are classified as retryable review-error conditions but currently vote -1, making the change invisible to backfill reconciliation forever

Retryable coverage-gap failures (review-error, llm-unavailable, scanner, gate-disabled, process-teardown) must cast no vote and defer re-drive to the backfill reconciler instead of posting a blocking -1 vote
The drain window must be sized to the full review duration (1200s) and the compose stop_grace_period scaled accordingly to allow in-flight reviews to complete before container shutdown
Bounded escalation after N consecutive retryable failures on the same revision must cast the fail-closed -1 with exhaustion note and emit VOTER_ERROR for alerting
